notes: REF-BM-02: only title is auto-fetched (titleFetcher.js); no description, favicon, or preview image are collected anywhere in schema/code. REF-BM-03: title editable pre/post save, but description doesn't exist as a field. REF-BM-04: url/title/tags/note editable via PUT; no description field exists to edit. REF-BM-06: on duplicate the UI only warns and, if confirmed, POSTs again with confirmDuplicate:true which creates a genuine second row (save.test.js asserts list length becomes 2) — this is the exact 'merely save it' anti-pattern the rubric calls out, not a converge-to-edit. REF-BM-07: list shows title/url/note/tags but no description or favicon (fields don't exist). REF-BM-10: tag input is plain comma-separated text with no datalist/autocomplete; the tag <select> is only a filter control, not entry assistance. REF-BM-14: search is one substring LIKE across title/url/note/tag name with no special '#tag' parsing — '#cooking' would not match a tag named 'cooking'. REF-BM-15: no boolean/parenthesis parser exists anywhere in the codebase (grep confirms). REF-BM-16: no quote-handling logic; quotes would be treated as literal characters in the substring match, not an exact-phrase directive. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag in schema (db.js) or model; no unread list/UI. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk endpoints exist. REF-BM-22: model/API supports only newest/oldest by created_at (no title sort) and there is no sort control in the UI (index.html/app.js), so a user cannot actually invoke it. REF-BM-23: note is rendered via escapeHtml as plain text, not markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot/archival-page code. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag or archive UI/endpoints. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity or saved-filter feature. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export code. REF-BM-32: no settings entity, font-size, or displayed-items controls.
